result:
Round 328 is written: it fixes the two status-text bugs that failed round 327, on A's uncommitted tree. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Why round 327 failed.** C failed it on C-R327-01 (Medium); C-R327-02 (Low) has the same cause. Gate 327 was skipped, so nothing was published and the base stays HEAD `234ccdd` plus A's 11 changed files. The cause was my own round-327 design, not A's work: the drag-preview text store was cleared before the real status update landed. So for about 6 ms the screen-reader status area showed the old "…added to the Music track" sentence, then re-added the fade text. A's proposed fix (option b) only solves the Low one, so I rejected it as the whole fix and ruled on A's STOP together with both findings.

**The round 328 fix** touches `ArrangementContext.tsx` only, plus three new tests (DP17–DP19) and doc 232. A applies my patch `b-round-327/sketch/sketch.patch.txt` with `git apply` and does not retype it. The fix:
- Stops clearing the store at the moment of the update.
- Clears it right after the update has been rendered instead.
- Takes over each preview text once only.
- Skips writing a preview text that is the same as the text already shown.

**What I ran on a scratch copy of the patch:**
- **C's own browser probe:** matches HEAD at both viewports (no changes in the status area, same element kept). On A's tree it still shows both bugs, so the probe is a valid check.
- **A new probe** for a refused key during the drag: identical on the patch, HEAD and A's tree.
- **Full test suite:** 3559/3559 pass; typecheck passes.
- **Mutants:** three of four fail their tests as intended. The one that recreates C-R327-01 itself passes in the jsdom test environment, because jsdom can't reproduce this timing. So the bug's acceptance check is the browser probe only; the task says so openly.
- I did not run the performance spec. C re-measures it, and no new budget rows were added.

**Bookkeeping:**
- The old task is copied to `tasks/round-327.md` (byte-equal).
- `backlog.json` is now v287, with decisions D-29z937…D-29z944. Nothing is marked done: stage b stays in progress because C failed it.
- New findings: C-R327-01/02, the reviewer's settle-order Low (moved to `deferred_low_polish`), and two signals. One of the signals is C's no-BPM ruler Alt-click observation, which goes to the regression round.
- A's architecture note is added as a non-blocking question for the open frontend-architect checkpoint (`b-round-327-checkpoint-addendum.md`).
- `feature-status.md`, `b-round-327.md` and `b-next.json` are written, with the full 34-item remaining list.

The advisor was available and I used it, before the ruling and before finishing. I followed its direction except one point: I dropped a check in the status footer that it suggested, because no test needed it. I consulted no project subagents, since this is a performance fix-up held to HEAD's behaviour.

**Next:** after C passes round 328, the gate publishes rounds 327 and 328 together. Round 329 should be the REGRESSION round, since it will be planned on or after 2026-11-05. Stage c of PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW comes after that.

I stopped the two dev servers I started (:5197, :5198). The store server on :5173 is untouched.
